text: This site's policy has been the same from the start: don't oversell what a tool can do. This chapter showed real places AI helps — it would be dishonest not to say, just as plainly, where it doesn't.
Every technique in this chapter worked from what you fed it. It has no access to the tribal knowledge that actually runs most real systems.
Whether a returned order still counts toward revenue is a judgment call from understanding the business, not pattern-matching text. An LLM cannot know which answer is right for this business.
A genuinely novel bug has no pattern to match — the draft in that case is often confidently wrong, not just uncertain.
Real help, honestly bounded. Next up: the chapter recap, tying all twenty lessons together before Chapter 4's capstone projects.
